description_en: Restores data to an existing instance across regions
description_zh: 该接口用于跨地域恢复数据到已有实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds restore-ddr-table --db-instance-id rm-bp0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --restore-type 0 --table-meta type_:_db_,_name_:_testdb1_,_newname_:_testdb1_,_tables_:_type_:_table_,_name_:_test1_,_newname_:_test1_backup_,_type_:_table_,_name_:_test2_,_newname_:_test2_backup --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestoreDdrTable

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the destination instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 目标地域ID，可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The method that is used to restore data. Valid values:

0: restores data from a backup set. If you set this parameter to 0, you must also specify the BackupSetId parameter.
1: restores data to a point in time. If you set this parameter to 1, you must also specify the RestoreTime, SourceRegion, and SourceDBInstanceName parameters.

Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh:
恢复方式，取值：
0：基于备份集恢复，还需要传入参数BackupId。
1：基于时间点恢复，还需要传入参数RestoreTime、SourceRegion、SourceDBInstanceName。

默认值：0
parameters.name: restore_type

parameters.help_en:
The cross-region backup set ID. You can call the DescribeCrossRegionBackups operation to query the IDs of the backup sets that are available to an instance.

If you set the RestoreType parameter to 0, you must also specify the BackupId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
跨地域备份集ID。可以通过接口DescribeCrossRegionBackups查询。
RestoreType=0时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time to which you want to restore data. The point in time that you specify must be earlier than the current time. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

If RestoreType is set to BackupTime, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 恢复时间点恢复的时间，需要早于当前时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the source instance if you want to restore data to a point in time.

: If you set RestoreType to 1, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复的来源地域。
RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: source_region

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the source instance whose data you want to restore to a point in time.

If you set the RestoreType parameter to 1, you must also specify the SourceDBInstanceName parameter
parameters.help_zh:
基于时间点恢复的来源实例ID。
RestoreType=1时需要传入此参数
parameters.name: source_db_instance_name

parameters.help_en: The names of the databases and tables that you want to restore. The value is in the following format: `[{"type":"db","name":"<The name of Database 1 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Database 1 on the destination instance>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<The name of Table 1 in Database 1 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Table 1 in Database 1 on the destination instance>"},{"type":"table","name":"<The name of Table 2 in Database 1 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Table 2 in Database 1 on the destination instance>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<The name of Database 2 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Database 2 on the destination instance>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<The name of Table 3 in Database 2 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Table 3 in Database 2 on the destination instance>"},{"type":"table","name":"<The name of Table 4 in Database 2 on the source instance>","newname":"<The name of Table 4 in Database 2 on the destination instance>"}]}]`
parameters.help_zh:
指定恢复的库表。格式：
```[{"type":"db","name":"<数据库1名称>","newname":"<新数据库1名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表1名称>","newname":"<新的表1名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表2名称>","newname":"<新的表2名称>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<数据库2名称>","newname":"<新数据库2名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表3名称>","newname":"<新的表3名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表4名称>","newname":"<新的表4名称>"}]}]```
parameters.name: table_meta
